items.raw_excerpt: The IamExpat Fair returns to Eindhoven on Saturday October 3 for its second outing in the city, with a bigger careers section, two international centres and a new kids area. The fair, which takes place in the Klokgebouw in Strijp-S, provides advice and services of all kinds for the international community, including special offers only available for attendees. You can register for free online. “We are bringing back the large career section, expanding the number of expat centres at the...
items.summary_en: The IamExpat Fair comes back to Eindhoven on Saturday, October 3. It runs at the Klokgebouw in Strijp-S. This year it has a bigger job area, two expat centres and a new zone for kids. Entry is free if you sign up online.
items.summary_ko: IAMExpat 박람회가 10월 3일 토요일에 에인드호벤에서 다시 열립니다. 장소는 스트리프-S의 클록헤보우입니다. 올해는 직업 구역이 커지고 외국인 지원 센터 두 곳과 어린이존이 새로 열립니다. 온라인 사전 신청을 하면 무료로 입장할 수 있습니다.
items.title_original: The IamExpat Fair is back in Eindhoven: what’s new this year?

items.summary_en: Union La Calera and Universidad Catolica play a Cup of Chile round of 16 match. Fans in Chile can see the first leg only on HBO Max. The article lists the match time and streaming options.

items.raw_excerpt: Taiwan debuted its first-ever national pavilion at a global transportation technology trade fair in Berlin on Tuesday, aimed at demonstrating resilient railway solutions and attracting international partners, officials said at the event.
items.summary_en: Taiwan showed up at a big transport technology fair in Berlin on Tuesday. It was the country's first national pavilion at this event. The pavilion shows resilient railway solutions and looks for international partners.
items.summary_ko: 대만은 화요일 베를린에서 열린 대형 교통 기술 전시회에 참가했습니다. 이번 대만 국가관 출전은 처음인 셈입니다. 국가관은 탄력 있는 철도 기술을 보여주고 해외 협력 상대를 찾는 자리입니다.
items.title_en: Taiwan Opens Its First National Pavilion at a Transport Fair in Berlin

items.raw_excerpt: Friendly shops, scenic trails, and historic landmarks make these Vermont towns some of the state's most welcoming destinations.
items.summary_en: These eight towns in Vermont are known for friendly shops, scenic trails, and historic landmarks. Travelers often call them the most welcoming places in the state. The list covers small towns across Vermont.
items.summary_ko: 버몬트에 있는 여덟 마을은 친절한 가게와 아름다운 트레일, 역사적인 명소로 알려져 있습니다. 여행자들은 이 마을들을 버몬트에서 가장 호감 좋은 장소로 찾는다고 말합니다. 이 목록은 버몬트 전역의 작은 마을들을 소개합니다.
items.title_original: 8 Most Hospitable Towns In Vermont - worldatlas.com

items.raw_excerpt: One of the first things you’ll want to do on arriving in Italy is start (or continue) learning the language, but tuition can be pricey: so where can you find affordable classes?
items.summary_en: Learning Italian is easier when the classes are free. Many towns and groups in Italy run free Italian lessons for visitors and new residents. Some libraries and online groups also offer lessons at no cost.
items.summary_ko: 이탈리아어는 무료 수업으로 배워 보면 훨씬 쉽다. 이탈리아의 여러 도시와 단체가 여행객과 새로 온 사람들을 위해 무료 이탈리아어 수업을 연다. 도서관이나 온라인 모임에서도 비용 없이 들을 수 있다.
items.title_en: Where to find free Italian lessons
items.title_original: Where to find free Italian lessons in Italy

items.raw_excerpt: Danish citizenship applicants affected by the pause in processing of applications have launched a campaign for applications to be resumed. We spoke to campaign organisers to find out more about their appeal.
items.summary_en: Denmark has paused the review of citizenship applications. The people who applied for citizenship have started a campaign and asked the country to start the review again. We spoke with the campaign organisers, and they say each application is about a real person and a real life.
items.summary_ko: 덴마크는 시민권 신청 심사를 일시 중단한 상태입니다. 신청자들은 심사를 다시 시작해 달라고 캠페인을 시작했습니다. 캠페인을 이끄는 사람들을 인터뷰해 보니 신청서 하나하나가 실제 한 사람의 인생과 연결되어 있다고 말했습니다.
items.title_en: Interview: A person is behind every citizenship application

items.title_original: INTERVIEW: ‘There is a person behind each Danish citizenship application’

items.raw_excerpt: Can being born in Norway grant you or your children residency rights later in life? The answer depends on several factors, such as the nationality of the parents.
items.summary_en: Being born in Norway does not always mean you can stay there later in life. It depends on your parents' nationality and the rules that apply. The article explains the main cases in simple words.

items.title_en: Born in Norway: Do You Get to Stay Later?

items.title_original: EXPLAINED: Can simply being born in Norway grant you residency rights?

items.raw_excerpt: When the residents of the Brabant town of Oisterwijk smelled the pungent odor of gas on Wednesday, they called their local fire department, who turned out to be the culprits. Fire fighters spent the morning searching for a gas leak to no avail. Together with gas provider Enexis, they tested levels throughout the town but could not find a source, only the smell. Meanwhile, back at the fire station, staff discovered a canister of THT was missing. The chemical is...
items.summary_en: People in the Dutch town of Oisterwijk smelled a strong gas odor and called the fire department. Firefighters and gas company Enexis searched all day but found no leak. At the station, they found a canister of the chemical THT was missing.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 오이스터베이크 마을 주민이 강한 가스 냄새를 느껴 소방에 신고했습니다. 소방관과 가스회사 넥시스가 하루 종일 마을을 샅망수색했지만 누출 지점은 찾지 못했습니다. 소방서로 돌아와 보니 소화약인 티에이치티 통이 사라져 있었습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: The Figueira da Foz City Council, on the coast of the Coimbra district, plans to complete 100 affordable housing units by year-end as part of the Recovery and Resilience Plan (PRR).
items.summary_en: The city of Figueira da Foz will build 100 low-cost homes by the end of the year. The city council says the project is part of Portugal's recovery plan. The houses will go to local families who need them.

items.raw_excerpt: Two men switched at birth in a rural Manitoba hospital in 1955 were awarded $250,000 each in the 2025-26 fiscal year, according to financial disclosure documents released by the province this week.
items.summary_en: Two men born at a small hospital in Arborg, Manitoba were sent home with the wrong families in 1955. Each received 250,000 dollars from the province. A DNA test found the mistake in 2022, and the premier apologized in 2024.
items.summary_ko: 1955년 마니토바주 아르보르그의 작은 병원에서 태어나 서로 다른 집으로 돌아간 두 남자가 각각 25만 달러를 도로부터 받았다. 2022년 한 친척의 유전자 검사로 사실을 알게 되었고, 2024년에는 주총사가 사과했다.
items.title_en: Two Manitoba men switched at birth in 1955 get $250K each
items.title_ko: 1955년 출생 때 서로 바뀌어 키운 두 마니토바 남자에게 각각 25만 달러
items.title_original: Manitoba compensates 2 men switched at birth in 1955 with $250K each in settlement

items.raw_excerpt: When Nova Scotia's Crown-run alcohol retailer and distributor pulled American booze from the shelves last year, it worked out to about $15 million worth of more than 600,000 units of product. While sales have resumed, there's only about $1.5 million of product left.
items.summary_en: Nova Scotia's public liquor agency took American alcohol off store shelves last year. That was more than 600,000 bottles worth about $15 million. Sales of American brands have started again, but only about $1.5 million of stock is left.
items.summary_ko: 노바스코티아의 공영 주류 판매 기관은 지난 해 미국산 술을 매대에서 내렸고, 이는 15만 달러 규모의 60만 병이 넘었다. 미국산 주류 판매는 다시 시작됐지만 남은 재고는 150만 달러 정도뿐이다.
items.title_en: Nova Scotia liquor store used up 90% of its American alcohol stock
items.title_ko: 노바스코티아 주류점, 미국산 술 재고 90% 소진
